summary: Verified both frontend bug fixes on StoreX admin. BUG 1 (Customers card crash): Fixed — clicking Customers metric on /admin now expands 'Customers Details' panel showing all 6 records including two 'Guest' users (with null lastName). No TypeError, no white screen. Toggling closed works. Regression check on Total Revenue and Total Orders passes — both expand their breakdown panels. BUG 2 (Revenue Trend blank chart): Fixed — /admin/analytics 'Revenue Trend' chart (data-testid=sales-chart) now renders 30 visible bars with varying heights. Range dropdown (analytics-range) reloads data correctly for 7d/30d. No console TypeErrors, no page errors on either screen.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page is at /login (not /admin/login). Use data-testid=login-email/login-password/login-submit. Admin sidebar/nav testids are not defined on metric cards — cards are clicked via visible text 'Total Revenue', 'Total Orders', 'Customers'. Chart uses data-testid=sales-chart; range selector uses data-testid=analytics-range.
